title: Halting from the Hit State
statement: Let $h$ be a bit string, let $mode$ be a Boolean mode, and let $v$ assign natural numbers to the nine registers, each at most $4|h|+4$. Starting in state $hit$ with register values $v$ and no answer, the machine in mode $mode$ halts with answer true if $mode$ is true, and otherwise with the bit of $h$ at position $v(0)$, interpreted as false when that position is outside $h$. Every configuration before halting satisfies the machine's safety condition and the same register bound.
